chains.title: EBF4 binds ref more at a PYDC2-AS1 intronic site; local regulatory consequence unproven
chains.element: rs13078086 lies in a PYDC2-AS1 intron, does not overlap an annotated cCRE, and is 42 bp from dELS EH38E2269392, so any EBF4 site would be in flanking sequence near but not within the annotated element core.
chains.cell_type: HCT116 is the supplied expression context; EBF4 is expressed at only 1.22 TPM, lower than several other candidates, and no EBF4 ChIP-seq data are provided, so occupancy in HCT116 is unproven.

links.claim: EBF4 binds the ref T allele more strongly than the alt G allele; QBiC-SELEX group G066 has best own model EBF4, z -60.28, effect -1.954, with EBF1 agreeing in direction. EBF4 is chosen within the EBF group because it has the best own-model score and the highest expression among group members listed (1.22 TPM versus EBF1 0.18, EBF2 0.73, EBF3 0.06).
The variant is in a PYDC2-AS1 intron with no cCRE overlap and 42 bp from dELS EH38E2269392, allowing only a nearby/flanking EBF4 site model rather than an annotated cCRE-core site.
The nearest plausible targets are PYDC2-AS1 and PYDC2, 19.5 kb upstream, but no colon transverse eQTL for this variant was detected, so the gene link remains proximity-only.
HCT116 expresses EBF4 at 1.22 TPM, so an EBF4-dependent effect is possible in the supplied cell type, but no EBF4 chromatin occupancy data are provided and expression is low.

There is no GWAS Catalog or Open Targets association for rs13078086, and the literature hits do not establish an EBF4- or PYDC2-AS1/PYDC2-specific colorectal cancer mechanism; any disease effect is speculative and indirect.
